about: Backend test shards for pull requests. mode: off = single full run only; shadow = single full run decides, shards run beside it and are compared; required = shards decide, the single full run only with the ci:full-backend label. Each boundary is the first class of the next shard in alphabetical order. Isolated classes (@IsolatedDatabase) run in their own shard with isolatedForks JVMs. Rebalance from the per-shard minutes in the Backend shard report.
